title: Forum checkpoint body
description: The operator signs the head of the forum's public chain at a point in time (register row DK791; spec-delta S1350), so the log witnesses it: the forum's act count (`forum_seq`) and the hash of its chain at that count (`forum_head`). Anyone who re-walks the forum chain can compare it with the latest checkpoint in the log; a forum act changed or a chain rewritten after a checkpoint no longer reproduces the signed hash. Signed by the operator; the log refuses any other issuer and a checkpoint that does not move forward (`forum_seq` greater than the last). Chain: none (prev is null). Credits are accounting entries, not money.

forum_seq.description: How many acts the forum chain held at the checkpoint.

forum_head.description: The hash of the forum chain's last entry at that count (`GET /forum/head`).
